queries.tables: SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS name,c.oid::text AS oid,COALESCE(s.n_live_tup,0) AS live,COALESCE(s.n_dead_tup,0) AS dead,COALESCE(s.seq_scan,0) AS seq_scan,COALESCE(s.idx_scan,0) AS idx_scan,COALESCE(s.n_tup_ins,0) AS inserts,COALESCE(s.n_tup_upd,0) AS updates,COALESCE(s.n_tup_del,0) AS deletes,COALESCE(s.autovacuum_count,0) AS autovacuum_count,COALESCE(s.autoanalyze_count,0) AS autoanalyze_count,s.last_autovacuum,s.last_autoanalyze,pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS bytes_total,COALESCE(s.n_mod_since_analyze,0) AS changed_since_analyze FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_all_tables s ON s.relid=c.oid WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname
queries.indexes: SELECT n.nspname||'.'||t.relname AS rel,ix.relname AS name,idx.indisunique AS is_unique,idx.indisprimary AS is_pk,idx.indisvalid AS valid,idx.indisready AS ready,pg_relation_size(ix.oid) AS bytes,COALESCE(st.idx_scan,0) AS scans,COALESCE(st.idx_tup_read,0) AS reads,COALESCE(st.idx_tup_fetch,0) AS fetches,md5(pg_get_indexdef(ix.oid)) AS md5 FROM pg_index idx JOIN pg_class ix ON ix.oid=idx.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=idx.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_all_indexes st ON st.indexrelid=ix.oid WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private') ORDER BY n.nspname,t.relname,ix.relname
queries.numeric_top25: SELECT r.rolname AS role_name,s.queryid::text AS fingerprint,s.calls,round(s.total_exec_time::numeric,3) AS total_ms,round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,3) AS mean_ms,round(s.max_exec_time::numeric,3) AS max_ms,s.rows,s.shared_blks_hit,s.shared_blks_read,s.temp_blks_read,s.temp_blks_written FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid WHERE s.calls>0 ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 25
queries.snapshot: SELECT now()::text AS observed_at_utc,(SELECT stats_reset::text FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AS db_stats_reset,(SELECT stats_reset::text FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements_info) AS statement_stats_reset,(SELECT count(*) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) AS migrations,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private')) AS app_sql_functions,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname IN ('public','private')) AS app_policies,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type='Lock') AS waiting_locks,(SELECT deadlocks FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AS cumulative_deadlocks,(SELECT count(*) FROM storage.buckets) AS storage_buckets
